bool path(apmatrix<int> A, 
          int i, int j) {
  int r = <*1>;
  apvector<bool> checked(r,false);
  apvector<bool> found(r,false);
  found[i]=true;
  bool progress=true;
  while(progress) {
    progress=false;
    for (int k=0; k<r; ++k) 
    {
      if (found[k]) {
        if (k==j) return true; 
        progress=true;
        found[k]=false;
        checked[k]=true;
        for (int z=0; z<r; ++z) {
          if(A[k][z] && 
                      !checked[z])
            found[z]=true;
        }
     }
  }
  return false;
}
